decisive_spans.text: MRI confirmed a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland

response.rationale: The presence of a large, predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland strongly supports Myelolipoma (D4) and Adrenal myelolipoma (D1). D4 is slightly preferred as it encompasses the broader description of the mass, while D1 is more specific to the adrenal gland, which was not visualized separately but the mass was in its location.
